steps.note: The task type, not a model name, chooses the route: chat, classify, summarise or extract, each a cheap model with no tools. The kit refuses an empty message list itself.

messages.content: Summarise the note in one sentence.
The lights on court 3 have flickered since Tuesday; the club has called the electrician.

body.content: Court 3's lights have flickered since Tuesday and an electrician has been called.

steps.note: Before sending, the gateway reserves the most the call could cost against every budget above the app, the organisation's overdraft limit and the app's own monthly allowance. The reply's figures are illustrative.

steps.code:
logger.LogInformation("{Model}: {In} in, {Out} out, {Credits} credits",
    reply.Model, reply.Usage.InputTokens, reply.Usage.OutputTokens, reply.Credits);
steps.note: Credits is what the call was settled at, its real cost, charged to the app's cascade; the reservation is released. The figures are illustrative.

body.title: The budget is exhausted
body.detail: The monthly budget for Labs has 0.0004 credits left; this call needs up to 0.016. Work stops until the budget is raised or a new month begins.
body.forAgent: This is terminal for the run: do not retry it.

steps.note: The scope and figures are illustrative.

steps.code:
try { reply = await models.CompleteAsync(request, ct); }
catch (EndgameBudgetExhaustedException e) { logger.LogWarning("{Message}", e.Message); }
output: The credit budget for this app is spent: The monthly budget for Labs has 0.0004 credits left; this call needs up to 0.016. Work stops until the budget is raised or a new month begins.

body.title: The credit budget is spent
body.detail: This feature is paused until the organisation tops up its credits.

steps.note: Left uncaught, the kit's error handler answers the app's caller like this, plus a traceId, and the web kit throws BudgetExhaustedError. The endpoint is an illustrative one of the app's own.

steps.note: The same code as a spent budget, told apart by bindingScope. The cap is 500 credits a month unless app_models.monthly_credits is set in the cascade. Figures illustrative.

steps.note: The kit throws its own EndgameOverdraftLimitException (Code "overdraft_limit", Status 402) in the platform's own words, and never retries it.
